forbidden_actions: remote Git, pull-request mutation, merge, deploy, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data
perform adjacent or downstream capability responsibilities
claim Phase 9 evaluation or release evidence that has not run
hard_gates: Proto-persona decoration, invented demographics, and generic journey stages must never be presented as customer evidence.
Preserve conflicts, counterevidence, unknowns, source identity, and authority boundaries.
inputs: Interview evidence, behavioral context, user hypotheses, and touchpoint observations.
responsibility: Model evidence-bounded actors, jobs, circumstances, desired progress, forces, and cross-touchpoint journeys without inventing persona facts.
